verification_report.summary: All three supplied proof blocks were checked in textual order. The single-star proof establishes the comparison sheaf, decreasing closure, finite slope budget, countable activity, and fixed-neighbourhood smoothing, including polar centres and full endpoints. The Stone-Euclidean proof establishes the stated product structure, common metrizable quotient, upper semicontinuity, convex fibres, and monotone regularization in every dimension. The combined proof preserves a common countable activity set, verifies compact-parameter maxima and endpoint traces, and constructs decreasing smooth approximations on one fixed product neighbourhood. All ten CLD citation groups were checked against the [2025 monograph](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1204.6277v2) after the required theorem-search and web-fallback sequence. The cited definitions and their hypotheses agree with their applications. No critical errors or unresolved gaps were found; all stated equalities and additional assertions follow for the specified structures.
